units: <cite ref="Ketubot 21b:3">Keth. 21ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>א׳ דדייני</he> the attestation by judges (h. <he>אַשָּׁרַת הדיינין</he>, v. <cite ref="A03354"><he>אַשָּׁרָה</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Bava Batra 163a:7">B. Bath. 163ᵃ</cite> <he>בין עדים לא׳</he> (Ar. a. Ms. <he>אשרא</he>) the space between the signature of the witnesses and the legal attestation.
<cite ref="Gittin 14a:17">Gitt. 14ᵃ</cite> R. S. had <he>א׳ דסרבלי וכ׳</he> money outstanding in Maḥuza for garments sold.
